answer: Comb builder brood frame warrant sealed by the forage office turns identity into something scarce. Because each brood frame is a year of forage maps in the apiary ledger, so a farm must draw a hundred real combs by hand, the trellis of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. The defender's bill stays flat — one quick verification per account — while the attacker's bill climbs with every clone, and the oasis is that asymmetry in plain numbers. The lantern is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
